name: beatable
description: Browse Xbox Game Pass and PS Plus games by completion time.

scripts.cap:copy: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap copy
scripts.cap:sync: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap sync && npm run cap:ios:sync-branding && npm run cap:android:sync-branding
scripts.cap:add:ios: npx cap add ios && npm run cap:ios:sync-branding
scripts.cap:add:android: npx cap add android && npm run cap:android:sync-branding
